summary: Greg Brockman cites a tax-prep pilot in which Codex processed 7,000 returns and cut preparation time by about a third, and points developers to OpenAI's open-source Codex harness for building their own products.

practices.reason: The tax-prep pilot metric is a single case-study result, not a transferable measurement method an engineering team could run.
practices.quote: a tax-prep pilot processed 7,000 returns and cut preparation time by about a third.

practices.reason: A link to an open-source harness is mentioned but no concrete interface change or migration requirement is described.
practices.quote: you can build your own products on our codex open-source harness
